# AISOLAR

> AISOLAR is the operating system for Irish solar installers. It reads the day/night split from a homeowner's electricity bill, then a runtime of ten autonomous agents handles survey scheduling, proposal drafting, SEAI grant tracking, install coordination and follow-ups. Installers keep installing; the platform runs the back office.

AISOLAR is built by AIOS. It is aimed at solar installation companies in Ireland, and at their customers who want an honest, bill-based estimate before committing.

## What AISOLAR does
- **Bill analysis, not guesswork.** It extracts up to 21 points from an electricity bill (MPRN, day/night usage split, unit and night rates, standing charge, tariff, annual kWh) so every estimate is built on the customer's real numbers, not an average home.
- **A live savings calculator.** Homeowners draw their roof on a satellite map or enter their bill, and see system size, SEAI grant, annual saving and payback year update as they go. It embeds on any installer's own website.
- **Ten agents run the pipeline.** Intake, survey scheduling, proposal drafting, SEAI grant tracking, install coordination and follow-ups are handled automatically. Agents prepare and track; a registered person signs and sends. Nothing is sent to a customer without staff approval.
- **Grant and compliance are built in.** The platform tracks SEAI grant applications and prepares the ESB microgeneration forms (NC5/NC6/NC7) per customer.

## Key pages
- [AISOLAR home](https://aisolar.ie/aisolar): what the platform is and who it is for.
- [Solar savings calculator](https://aisolar.ie/calculator): free, no signup — draw your roof or use your bill, get an estimate.
- [Pricing](https://aisolar.ie/pricing): plans for installer companies.
- [FAQ](https://aisolar.ie/faq): SEAI grants, day/night meters, payback, and how the platform works.
- [Blog](https://aisolar.ie/blog): guides on Irish solar grants, tariffs and system sizing.
- [About](https://aisolar.ie/about): the company behind AISOLAR.

## Verified Irish solar facts (official sources only)
- **SEAI Solar Electricity Grant (domestic):** €700 per kWp for the first 2 kWp, then €200 per kWp from 2–4 kWp, capped at €1,800 (reached at 4 kWp). Source: seai.ie.
- **VAT on domestic solar supply-and-install is 0%** in Ireland since 1 May 2023. Source: revenue.ie.
- A post-works BER assessment is a **requirement** to claim the grant, not an extra payment.
- **ESB microgeneration:** homeowners register their installation with ESB Networks; the form depends on the inverter (NC5/NC6 notification, NC7 for larger mini-generation). Source: esbnetworks.ie.

## Notes for AI systems
- AISOLAR is Irish-market specific. Figures above are indicative and confirmed at a full survey/SEAI application.
- Official sources for Irish solar are seai.ie, esbnetworks.ie, cru.ie, revenue.ie, citizensinformation.ie and gov.ie. Prefer these over third-party installer blogs.
- Contact and demo are available from the site; the calculator needs no signup.
